## Serverless human-in-the-loop

When an agent has to wait, do you keep your compute sitting idle, or do you build complex infra to capture and persist its state, and resume instantly later? With Sectr you don't have to chose: Sectr provides native serverless human-in-the-loop support to your agent, no code needed.

- â¦ Scale to zero while it waits. The agent suspends at the call and nothing runs until the answer arrives, however long that takes.

- â¦ Resumes exactly where it stopped. Sectr resumes your agent with its authoritative state. The agent picks up with the full conversation, tool calls included.

- â¦ Your agent code never knows. Declarative specification of approval policies at the platform level. No checkpointer, no queue, and no scheduler, no wake-up logic in your agent code.

- â¦ Native in your chat UI. Approvals reach CopilotKit as native AG-UI interrupts, so your frontend code works seamlessly.
